notices.title: Stratford (London) Rail Station
notices.detail: MILDMAY LINE: Sunday 18 October, until 1115, no service between Gospel Oak and Stratford. Replacement bus service S operates between Gospel Oak (Southampton Road / Agincourt Road) and Stratford via Kentish Town West, Camden Road, Holloway Road (Piccadilly line), Highbury & Islington (for Caledonian Road & Barnsbury), Canonbury (St Pauls Road), Dalston Junction (for Dalston Kingsland), Hackney Central, Homerton and Hackney Wick.

notices.title: Stratford (London) Rail Station
notices.detail: MILDMAY LINE: Sunday 18 October, after 2215, no service between Camden Road and Stratford. Rail replacement buses will run as follows: Service S: Camden Road - Holloway Road (Piccadilly line) - Highbury & Islington - Canonbury - Dalston Junction (for Dalston Kingsland) - Hackney Central - Homerton - Hackney Wick - Stratford. For Caledonian Road & Barnsbury use local bus route 274 to/from Camden Road or walk to/from Highbury & Islington. Some buses continue on request westbound only from Camden Road as follows: Camden Road - Kentish Town West - Gospel Oak (bus stop in Southampton Road) - Hampstead Heath - Finchley Road Tube (for Finchley Road & Frognal) - West Hampstead - Brondesbury (bus stops in Kilburn High Road) - Queen's Park (walk/local buses for Brondesbury Park) - Kensal Rise - Willesden Junction - Acton Central - South Acton - Gunnersbury - Kew Gardens (Royal Botanic Gardens) - Richmond. Last through trains: Richmond to Stratford 2110; Camden Road to Stratford 2203; Stratford to Richmond 2201; Stratford to Clapham Junction 22:08
